mission_phase: Generation 38 - Three-dataset Cortex-judged relevance scoreboard (Home Improvement: Home Depot + Lowe's)
phase_goal: Turn the dataset x retailer search scoreboard into a graded-relevance evaluation across three query datasets, judged by a local LLM (Cortex / llama3.2:3b) with auditable per-(query,product) traces. Datasets: (1) synonym/category consistency, (2) dimensions - notation & hash sensitivity, (3) pro/job-function project & trade queries. Each dataset shows an NDCG-based score per retailer (Home Depot, Lowe's), drillable to per-query NDCG and per-product grades (3 perfect -> 0 irrelevant) with the judge's reason, plus count-band ratio and SKU-overlap Jaccard chips for the dimensions dataset. Evidence captured via bounded same-origin browser reads (no crawling/API/token-replay).
reason_generation_started: Operator delivered two additional datasets (dimensions, then pro/job-function) and asked to see, in the UI, per-retailer NDCG for Home Depot vs Lowe's, drillable to the actual results at query and query+product level, leveraging the shared Cortex relevance service.
standing_directive: Scores from captured browser-driven evidence only (bounded, same-origin, real session). Relevance graded by Cortex; counts deterministic. Do not fabricate grades or counts. Never record a validation claim not actually performed. Keep work local; commit only when the operator asks.

functional: The Home Improvement search view shows a dataset x retailer scoreboard with THREE datasets (synonym consistency, dimensions relevance, pro relevance) and a score per retailer.
Relevance datasets drill from dataset score to per-query NDCG and from a query to per-product graded relevance (0-3) with the judge's one-line reason.
Dimensions queries also surface count-band ratio and SKU-overlap Jaccard; the structure stays dataset-generic so future datasets slot in as rows.
Product titles sent to the judge are full (not truncated) for the truncation-critical fastener queries; the Cortex notation/No.-abbreviation defect is fixed and re-judged.
usability: Interactive walkthrough: open the scoreboard, read HD vs Lowe's per dataset, drill a score to per-query NDCG, expand a query to per-product grades; Shopify/Woo sites unaffected.
No inspection triggered; no server-side fetching of the retailers.
technical: validate:dashboard asserts the search-datasets API returns datasets with per-retailer scores + cases and the view renders the relevance branch (severity dots, grade badges); validate:gen13 and validate stay green; git diff --check clean.

validation_notes: VAL-087: three-dataset scoreboard (Synonym HD 30 / Lowe's 48; Dimensions HD 90 / Lowe's 88; Pro HD 83 / Lowe's 78) with query- and product-level drill-down; Cortex judge notation + 'No.' abbreviation defects found, fixed (validated 12/13 gold, stable), delivered to and deployed by the Cortex session, then re-judged; two clean gate passes.

Pro dataset: 3 queries (electrician, landscaper on both; install a toilet on Lowe's) genuinely return 0 products.
